name: Give me the boring bit
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Design an exceptional CONVERSION-FOCUSED WEBSITE HERO for Perry, a screen-aware Mac companion, as a single polished 1536x1024 landscape screenshot. The hero must instantly explain usefulness and invite trying the product. This is a proposed website demo, not a claim that a browser controls the visitor's Mac.
Visual direction: happy, mischievous, bright white notebook paper with almost imperceptible grain, confident huge black grotesk type, one lively lemon-yellow accent. No sepia, sad school notebook rules, dusty chalk, paper sculptures or generically floating cards. Perry is a charming SMALL dry-black-ink stick person: circular unfilled head, exactly two upright oval eyes, no mouth, spare expressive limbs.
Layout: small handwritten 'perry' top-left. Top right quiet 'How it works', sun/moon icon. Upper half dramatic left-aligned 95px headline exactly 'Give me the\nboring bit.' with a broad vivid pale-lemon marker swipe under 'boring'. Under it exact plain copy 'Perry uses your Mac with you. Ask, learn, or hand over a task.' Large black primary CTA 'Get Perry for Mac' with simple arrow. Keep it visible and unobscured.
The lower half is ONE large, beautiful Mac-like Finder demo window set directly on the page, extremely crisp and legible. Clean almost-white toolbar with traffic lights and 'Desktop'. Inside are exactly six clearly readable files scattered at one side, named 'Brief.pdf', 'Notes.txt', 'Sketch.png', 'Plan.pdf', 'Photo.jpg', 'Draft.txt'; at the opposite side two clear folder destinations 'Documents' and 'Images'. No OS desktop wallpaper. A spectacular but SIMPLE broad hand-drawn black lasso extends OUT OF the demo window into the web page; Perry stands on its top edge with both feet planted, hauling the lasso to gather the scattered files. No extra physical props or limbs. The state is poised just before sorting, with files neatly readable, no trails or motion blur. Perry cheerfully looks toward visitor. Across the demo's bottom is a real visible action row with small label 'Try a website demo', text 'Put these files in folders', and ONE yellow button 'Let Perry try →'. A small handwritten 'your turn to relax.' near mascot. Clear distinction between black acquisition CTA and yellow demo action. Large visual, direct useful promise, fun with a job to do, ample breathing room, premium contemporary graphic design. NO abstract-only poster, no decorative paper tear, no fake metrics, no fake testimonials, no AI sparkle, no nested card grid, no tutorial annotation board. All text readable, all controls fit in viewport.

name: Learn by doing
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a remarkable functional Perry homepage HERO, a single finished 1536x1024 desktop screenshot. Perry is a Mac companion that teaches users inside the app they are using. The visual must HOOK a visitor through a clear useful playable demo. Style is warm, optimistic, witty hand-ink on clean white paper, with cobalt-blue accents and superb editorial typography, NOT a melancholy school notebook or a generic split SaaS card layout.
Composition: small hand-lettered black 'perry' upper-left, upper-right 'Get Perry for Mac' black text with arrow and tiny theme control. Across the top, enormous clear black sans headline exactly 'Learn it by doing it.' The words 'doing it' have one lively blue hand-drawn underline, same font throughout. Under headline, short body 'Perry points to the next step, right inside your Mac apps.' A black filled CTA 'Get Perry for Mac' and quieter plain text 'Try a lesson below'.
Central/lower hero contains a single large precise native Mac Finder window titled 'Desktop' occupying 65 percent width, offset left. Show two selected document icons 'Brief.pdf' and 'Notes.txt' and a CLEAN legible context menu with just 'Open', 'New Folder with Selection', 'Move to Trash'. Highlight ONLY 'New Folder with Selection' with cobalt selected background and white text. The browser demo has small subtle 'Interactive lesson' text above it, so this is not pretending to see a visitor's real computer.
The amazing signature: at right a very large expressive handwritten cobalt word 'here.' whose terminal ink stroke curves into a long elegant arrow ending exactly at the highlighted menu option. A SMALL adorable black stick-figure Perry balances on the curved arrow, arms extended like a helpful guide, circular unfilled head, two upright oval eyes, no mouth. The lettering, arrow, character and REAL lesson target form one magnificent graphic composition. Under the menu, clearly visible instruction 'Click New Folder with Selection'. Under the demo one tiny 'Step 1 of 2' and a quiet 'Let Perry do it instead' control. Avoid decorative duplicate arrows; just one. Hierarchy headline -> understandable example -> actionable highlighted target. Delight is attached to a real action. Finely controlled ink edges, near-white background, energetic typography, NO physical notebook, moody grain, neon, robot, 3D paper object, feature-card grid, fake endorsements, complex dashboard, scattered doodles, redaction or extra annotation labels. Everything fits above the fold.

name: Teach the repeat
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Invent a high-conversion Perry website hero about teaching a repeatable Mac task. Render a single outstanding 1536x1024 landscape website screenshot. Product truth: Perry can observe a user-started demonstration, draft a routine for review, and replay it. The image depicts a website simulation, not actual browser access to the user's Mac. Make the purpose and next action instantly clear.
Art direction: HAPPY SCREENPRINT STUDIO, rich sunny pale-yellow paper as the full page background, bold near-black type and white clean interface surfaces. This is the most graphically daring concept: dramatic horizontal rhythm, one huge repeat-loop of black ink, bright and friendly. NOT beige scrapbook, no sad notebook, no generic bento, no 3D popup book, no robot, no neon.
Upper-left small expressive black 'perry'; upper-right restrained 'How it works' and black sun/moon icon. Main 90px headline at left on two lines, exactly 'Do it once.\nTeach Perry.' Beneath it smaller exact copy 'Show Perry the steps. Review the routine. Run it again when you need it.' Solid near-black CTA 'Get Perry for Mac' with white type.
Across the middle/right, ONE crisp Mac Finder demo window on a slightly skewed white rectangular paper inset, strong purposeful geometry, minimum shadows, titled 'Rename files'. It shows three actual legible filename rows: 'Photo 01.jpg', 'Photo 02.jpg', 'Photo 03.jpg'. Below rows a small native input labelled 'Prefix' containing 'Summer', and a black 'Rename' button. Just below this window a compact attached strip reads 'Website demo' and has a large clearly clickable outlined control 'Show Perry once →'. A small handwritten annotation 'next time, I’ve got it.' sits near mascot.
One magnificent thick hand-ink loop sweeps behind the demo, wraps around its right side and returns beneath it as a curved arrow; its shape signals repetition with just one arrowhead. Small black stick-person Perry with round unfilled head, TWO vertical eyes, no mouth, sits astride the returning ink stroke, holding a SIMPLE white checklist with three ticks, eager posture. Beneath the loop on lower-right is a white perforated paper ticket printed cleanly 'Rename a batch' and 'Review routine →', readable as the task the demo will teach. Do not invent completed counts or success statistics. All parts belong to ONE routine demo, not a gallery of cards. Strong controlled contrast between massive type, one loop, small helpful character and real UI. Full hero fits viewport with visible primary CTA, 30 percent open yellow space, bright original brand campaign with practical conversion.

name: Say it. See it happen.
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a brilliant, instantly understandable product website HERO for Perry, a voice-capable Mac companion. Single desktop screenshot 1536x1024. This is a simulated website demo, no live microphone or real computer access implied. The visitor should understand: ask Perry to do a task, preview it, then let it run.
Visual: a LIVELY black sketchbook page, smooth charcoal with barely visible texture, huge warm ivory typography, sunny yellow ink gestures and one warm little stickman. NOT depressive, no creepy atmosphere, no office diorama, no lamps, no clutter, no sci-fi glow, no generic dark SaaS gradients.
Composition bold and full-width: small ivory handwritten 'perry' top-left; clear ivory filled 'Get Perry for Mac' CTA at top-right with sun/moon control beside it. Large two-line typography in upper-left half reads exactly 'Say it.\nSee it happen.' in confident contemporary broad sans. Subtext directly beneath 'Talk to Perry. It can guide you or take a task off your hands.'
An oversized HANDWRITTEN ivory speech ribbon arcs across the right half reading exactly 'Put these in Archive.' on one expressive curve, with a yellow highlighter swipe behind 'Archive'. The trailing end of the speech line turns into an arrow entering a single Mac Finder demo window across the lower center. This is not a speech bubble card; lettering is directly on the paper. Finder window uses dark graphite native UI, readable title 'Desktop', two selected document icons 'Brief.pdf' and 'Notes.txt', a clearly visible folder 'Archive'. A small black top-center NOTCH integrated into demo window expands into a pale-ivory paper plan slip, just enough to show 'Create Archive · Move 2 files' and a high-contrast yellow 'Run demo →' button. A tiny ivory stick-figure Perry sits on the notch's edge gripping the descending speech line like a rope; unfilled circle head with TWO vertical eyes, no mouth, cheerful alert stance. At bottom-left of the demo, a compact playable circular button with triangle and label 'Play sample request' plus understated 'Website demo'. There is NO microphone recording state; this is prerecorded sample playback. The illustration makes speech literally become an action path, immediately connected to an understandable file operation and run control.
One strong graphic gesture, clean letterforms, superb contrast, intimate mascot within purposeful UI. Acquisition CTA and useful demo are both visible without scrolling. No abstract art disconnected from product, no feature grid, no fictitious testimonials, no claims of instant or autonomous completion, no hardware laptop frame. Elegant, witty and exuberant.
